description: This file declares interfaces and classes for the PUSCH channel estimator based on DM-RS in 5G NR, including configuration structures, estimator interface, results interface, and notifier for estimation completion.

classes.name: dmrs_pusch_estimator_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the completion of the PUSCH channel estimation process.

classes.name: dmrs_pusch_estimator
classes.description: Interface for estimating the PUSCH channel based on DM-RS signals.

classes.name: dmrs_pusch_estimator_results
classes.description: Interface for accessing the results of the PUSCH DM-RS channel estimation.

methods.name: on_estimation_complete
methods.description: Callback invoked when the estimation process completes, providing the results.

methods.name: estimate
methods.description: Performs the channel estimation given a resource grid and configuration, notifying upon completion.

methods.name: get_noise_variance
methods.description: Returns the estimated noise variance for a given Rx port.

methods.name: get_rsrp
methods.description: Returns the RSRP for a specific Rx port and Tx layer.

methods.name: get_rsrp_all_ports
methods.description: Returns RSRP estimates for all Rx ports for a given Tx layer.

methods.name: get_epre
methods.description: Returns the average EPRE for a given Rx port.

methods.name: get_snr
methods.description: Returns the estimated SNR for a given Rx port.

methods.name: get_layer_average_snr
methods.description: Returns the average SNR across layers for a given Tx layer.

methods.name: get_time_alignment
methods.description: Returns the estimated time alignment between the Rx port and the reference.

methods.name: get_cfo_Hz
methods.description: Returns the carrier frequency offset in Hz for a given Rx port, if available.

methods.name: get_symbol_ch_estimate
methods.description: Retrieves the channel estimates for a specific OFDM symbol, Rx port, and Tx layer.

methods.name: get_symbol_ch_estimate (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves channel estimates for specific REs flagged in a mask.

methods.name: get_channel_state_information
methods.description: Provides the general channel state information.
